Flight · Latvia

Drone crosses eastern Latvia and leaves for Russia

1 November 2026 · Krāslava–Ludza · Foreign drone crosses Latvian airspace

Officially described drone incursion; exited into Russia

Officials described one drone entering eastern Latvia from Belarus around 19:00 on 1 November 2026 and leaving for Russia at 19:16. Its operator and purpose remain unestablished.

Latvia launched a BLAZE interceptor and destroyed its own aircraft at 19:19 to avoid a border crossing. This was not a reported shoot-down of the foreign drone. The regional map point is approximate.
